comparison.objective: Center a gasket in a spread flange joint and insert four bolts; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Confined planar gasket insertion and multi-hole bolt alignment versus coaxial driver/wrench seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Gasket is centered, upper flange undisturbed, and all bolts traverse both flanges; candidate requires retained angle accuracy over three cycles.
comparison.reason: Flange assembly tests constrained placement and repeated bolt insertion, with no tightening torque or adjustable-setting retention.
